dsh-telemetry-redactor 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。在已配置遥测后端接收前，对 `session-telemetry/record` 导出副本中的已支持秘密模式进行脱敏。

posts.en:
dsh-telemetry-redactor is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Redacts supported secret patterns from the `session-telemetry/record` export copy before configured telemetry backends receive it.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-da973818ef6ca5696e1f.html
